name: support_status_verifier
description: Three-class support classifier (supported / partial / unsupported). Reads the proposed answer + reason + claimed status and re-classifies against the evidence. Returns JSON with support_status, answer_acknowledges_gap, supported_facts, missing_or_ambiguous_facts, reason.
system: You classify answer support status using only supplied document evidence.
notes: Pre-registry source: src/generation/prompts.py::build_support_status_verification_prompt. Called by AnswerGenerator.verify_support_status when the initial generation declined to mark supported=true and the trace pipeline wants a second-opinion on whether the answer is truly unsupported or merely partial.
